title: The Famine and Atonement with the Gibeonites
description:
A three-year famine in David's days reveals that blood guilt rests on Saul's house because Saul had broken the oath and killed the Gibeonites.  
David hands over seven of Saul's descendants – two sons of Rizpah and five grandsons through Merab – who are hanged at Gibeah, while Mephibosheth, Jonathan's son, is spared for the sake of the oath.  
Rizpah faithfully guards the bodies from harvest until the rain comes, and David arranges to bring the bones of Saul and Jonathan from Jabesh in Gilead and bury them in the family tomb at Zela in Benjamin's land.  
After this, God responded to prayer for the land.
